title: Knowledge Continuity

organization.name: Northstar Field Systems Cooperative
organization.description: Fictional Canadian field-services organization used only for the Konnaxion demonstration.
organization.operating_context: Legacy field systems, procurement governance, and precision workshop practice.

promise: If a critical expert becomes unavailable tomorrow, can the organization still perform the capability safely and explain why?

success_state.principle: A capability is covered only after independent practice and evidence-based validation; document count alone is not continuity.

rules: A historical outcome is not automatically a reusable rule.
Tacit expertise may be elicited but must not be falsely represented as fully codified.
Stockage preserves evidence; Knowledge interprets it; Konservation preserves human provenance.
Smart Vote and public consultation are intentionally absent from the core flow.

capability_lifecycle.covered_rule: At least one validated backup has demonstrated independent practice with evidence and peer approval.
capability_lifecycle.principle: Lifecycle describes organizational continuity, not learner engagement.
